name: KEEPMARK-carried-unsaid
note: a shed or refused replica read says no bookmark, the page forgets its own, and its next reads start at the primary

name: KEEPMARK-timeout-forgets
note: a read past its wait - the overload's own answer - sends every next read to the primary

name: KEEPMARK-write-timeout-keeps
note: a write that timed out may have landed; a replica from before it would read it unmade
